svg.text: Straight-line CVPR figure derived from the provided PyTorch implementation
Three-scale dual encoder with dominance cross-attention
v: B x 3 x H x W
i: B x 1 x H x W

Faithfulness check: this figure matches the provided code structure: _content_cue, v1/i1-v3/i3 encoders, ca1-ca3, fuse_top, up2/dec2, up1/dec1, out_rgb, out_ir_w, target_y, pred_mix, luminance ratio color recovery, and auxiliary outputs.
Connector convention: solid blue/red = VIS/IR feature flow; dashed gray = cue/skip buses; purple = fused decoder flow; green = output reconstruction.
